fields.description: A unique, human-readable name for this execution profile.
fields.label: Profile Name

fields.description: If checked, this is a built-in profile shipped with Huf. Built-in profiles are reused across agents and snapshotted at execution time.
fields.label: Is Built-in

fields.description: If checked, this profile is disabled and cannot be used for new executions.
fields.label: Disabled

fields.description: How executions under this profile are approved. 'Ask Every Time' creates an Agent Execution Approval record and pauses the tool call until approved.
fields.label: Approval Mode
fields.options:
Auto Approve
Ask Every Time
Never Allow

fields.description: Filesystem access granted to the sandboxed interpreter.
fields.label: Filesystem Policy

fields.description: Optional network egress allowlist applied to the sandbox broker's http.request capability.
fields.label: Network Access Policy

fields.description: List of stdlib/library module names the sandboxed interpreter is allowed to import.
fields.label: Allowed Modules

fields.description: Maximum wall-clock time (seconds) a single execution may run.
fields.label: Max Wall Time (s)

fields.description: Maximum CPU time (seconds) a single execution may consume.
fields.label: Max CPU Seconds

fields.description: Maximum memory (MB) the sandboxed interpreter may allocate.
fields.label: Max Memory (MB)

fields.description: Maximum combined stdout/stderr size (bytes) captured from an execution.
fields.label: Max Output (bytes)

fields.description: Capabilities the sandbox broker is allowed to invoke back into Frappe under the acting user's permissions.
fields.label: Permissions
